meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 装上后，面对多步骤任务，Claude 会把各步骤按依赖关系组成一张节点图，一次只执行图上当前阶段；节点失败或跑偏时，它会用重试、补充指令或修改定义的方式来恢复，已完成的部分不会重做。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 mass-ulw、要求按任务 DAG 执行，或要求做需要部分任务等另一些任务完成的扇出工作时。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑这个任务图：做完 A 和 B，再启动 C
say.note: 会建立依赖节点并按阶段推进

say.text: 帮我用 mass-ulw 重试刚才失败的那个节点
say.note: 只重试该节点，其他已完成结果保留

say.text: 把这几步拆成有依赖关系的多阶段，用 mass-ulw 执行
say.note: 每个阶段只跑该阶段能开始的节点

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude organizes multi-step jobs into a dependency-ordered node graph and runs only the current phase at a time. Failed or drifting nodes are recovered via retry, steering messages, or definition edits; completed work is reused.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait for others.

say_en.text: Run this graph with mass-ulw: do A and B first, then start C.
say_en.note: Builds dependency nodes and advances by phase.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to retry the node that just failed.
say_en.note: Only that node is retried; finished results are kept.

say_en.text: Split these steps into dependency-ordered phases and run them with mass-ulw.
say_en.note: Each phase only runs nodes whose dependencies are clear.
